id: title:VojtechBartos:stop routing device type words to a mobile project

review.posthog_relevance: Adds workspace and mobile project definitions and a device-word routing case to the Slack App's project classifier.
review.reason: The chunk is dominated by documentation and test changes, but P1.F3.H1 contains implementation changes adding workspace and mobile project definitions and a device-word routing case. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and configuration update.
review.uncertainty: The chunk is dominated by documentation and test changes, and the implementation changes are not accompanied by tests or documentation, so the benefit is not fully demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and test changes. P1.F3.H1 and P1.F3.H2 add new workspace definitions and evaluation cases, but P1.F3.H3 and P1.F3.H4 are documentation and test assertion changes. P1.F3.H5 and P1.F3.H6 are also documentation and test changes. No implementation changes are supplied.
